issue_context.title: Use fixed TblInfoID in `stabilizeGetStatsTblInfo`
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
Use fixed TblInfoID in `stabilizeGetStatsTblInfo`.

Otherwise, we need to change it when we delete or add a new system table. You can see: https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/45969/commits/904b95348435adf8085ab1cd42308ce4b54d8a86

review_comments: Add a comment here to inform it which is used in test.
